---
title: "试验参与者基线特征"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===== 1. 检查并安装必要包 =====
packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "rstatix")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# ===== 2. 模拟临床试验数据 =====
set.seed(2026)

n_per_group <- 30   # 每组30例，可调
total_n <- n_per_group * 2

# 生成患者基本信息
data <- data.frame(
  患者ID = paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:total_n)),
  治疗组 = rep(c("试验组", "对照组"), each = n_per_group),
  年龄 = round(rnorm(total_n, mean = 55, sd = 12), 0),
  性别 = sample(c("男", "女"), total_n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4)),
  # 基线值（如收缩压，均值140，标准差15）
  基线值 = round(rnorm(total_n, mean = 140, sd = 15), 1),
  # 治疗后值（试验组平均降低15，对照组降低5）
  治疗后值 = ifelse(
    data$治疗组 == "试验组", 
    round(data$基线值 - rnorm(total_n, mean = 15, sd = 8), 1),
    round(data$基线值 - rnorm(total_n, mean = 5, sd = 8), 1)
  )
)

# 计算变化值（基线 - 治疗后，正值表示改善）
data$变化值 <- data$基线值 - data$治疗后值

# ===== 3. 表1：基线特征（按治疗组） =====
# 连续变量：均值±标准差
baseline_continuous <- data %>%
  group_by(治疗组) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    年龄均值_SD = paste0(round(mean(年龄), 1), "±", round(sd(年龄), 1)),
    基线值均值_SD = paste0(round(mean(基线值), 1), "±", round(sd(基线值), 1))
  )

# 分类变量：n（%）
baseline_categorical <- data %>%
  group_by(治疗组, 性别) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(治疗组) %>%
  mutate(百分比 = round(count / sum(count) * 100, 1),
         显示 = paste0(count, " (", 百分比, "%)")) %>%
  select(治疗组, 性别, 显示) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 性别, values_from = 显示, values_fill = "0 (0%)")

# 合并为最终表1（用左连接整合）
table1 <- baseline_continuous %>%
  left_join(baseline_categorical, by = "治疗组") %>%
  # 重新排序列，方便阅读
  select(治疗组, N, 年龄均值_SD, 男, 女, 基线值均值_SD)

# 打印表1
knitr::kable(table1, 
      caption = "表1. 患者基线特征（均值±标准差 / n（%））",
      align = "c") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

# ===== 4. 表2：疗效结果（基线、治疗后、变化值、组间p值） =====
# 先计算各组描述统计
summary_eff <- data %>%
  group_by(治疗组) %>%
  summarise(
    基线_均值_SD = paste0(round(mean(基线值), 1), "±", round(sd(基线值), 1)),
    治疗后_均值_SD = paste0(round(mean(治疗后值), 1), "±", round(sd(治疗后值), 1)),
    变化值_均值_SD = paste0(round(mean(变化值), 1), "±", round(sd(变化值), 1))
  )

# 进行两组间变化值的t检验
t_test_res <- t.test(变化值 ~ 治疗组, data = data)
p_value <- round(t_test_res$p.value, 4)

# 将p值放入单独一行，但为了表格美观，我们创建一个汇总行
p_row <- data.frame(
  治疗组 = "p值",
  基线_均值_SD = "",
  治疗后_均值_SD = "",
  变化值_均值_SD = as.character(p_value)
)

# 将p行绑定到汇总表
table2 <- bind_rows(summary_eff, p_row)

knitr::kable(table2, 
      caption = "表2. 疗效指标（收缩压）前后变化及组间比较",
      align = "c") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```
